items.title: In graphic detail: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem
items.excerpt: For OpenAI, turning ChatGPT’s audience into a $100 billion ad business depends on advertiser demand, measurement and monetisation.

items.title: Agencies find AI overuse is leading to brief bloat
items.excerpt: Agencies and marketers now frequently use AI tools to create media and creative briefs. But the practice could be a canary in the coalmine for AI overuse in advertising.

items.title: How Fresh Step used AI to go from brief to ads at one-tenth the cost
items.excerpt: To address ongoing category pressure, the Clorox cat litter brand worked with agency RECE to get a new campaign in market in about a month.

items.title: Levi’s claymation holiday campaign celebrates handmade craft amid AI bloat
items.excerpt: The nostalgic effort follows a back-to-school campaign that CEO Michelle Gass said failed to generate the expected demand and traffic.

items.title: Amazon adds over 100 Alexa for Shopping functions
items.excerpt: New capabilities include managing subscriptions, resolving billing questions, and creating and editing lists and registries.

items.title: Walmart ramps up Sparky features in time for the holidays
items.excerpt: New visual recognition and cart generation capabilities for the AI assistant aim to ease the pain of holiday shopping, both online and in stores.

items.title: Google makes big plans for wallet
items.excerpt: The tech giant thinks a digital wallet should act as a repository for receipts, track online orders and arrange refunds, among other tasks.

items.title: Ads In Google AI Answers Concentrate In Apparel & Electronics
items.excerpt: New holiday data counts ads inside Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and ChatGPT across five shopping categories and shows which prompts ChatGPT ads ran on.

items.title: Google Brings UCP Direct Checkout To AI Mode In Canada
items.excerpt: Google is expanding UCP-powered direct checkout in AI Mode and the Gemini app to Canadian shoppers, with a Merchant Center integration planned for next year.

items.title: Google Search Queries Hit A 5-Year High, And Search Revenue Didn’t Follow
items.excerpt: Alphabet’s Q3 numbers show AI Mode growing faster than it earns, and every reason Google gave for the slowdown is temporary except one.

items.title: Microsoft Clarity puts Shopify and WooCommerce products in Copilot and Bing
items.excerpt: Accepting the terms sends a store catalog to Microsoft Merchant Center; agent tracking sees only Google, OpenAI and Anthropic. Who qualifies, and at what cost?

items.title: Bot protection blocks Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 of 200 retailers
items.excerpt: Large retailers refused the agent at a 20% rate, emerging ones at 2.5%, yet all 24 refusers with readable robots.txt allow AI crawlers. Who set those blocks?

items.title: Meta's API v27 may add catalog products to new ads by default
items.excerpt: From today on v27.0, and on all versions in about 90 days, new device-targeted Sales ad sets widen by default. Which catalog and lookalike API calls now fail?

items.title: Criteo Is A Survivor, But Expanding Beyond Retail Media Will Be Its Toughest Challenge Yet
items.excerpt: Criteo has weathered considerable storms in its day, including a painful moment in March 2020 when its market cap bottomed out below $500 million. items.title: AI Is Both Canva’s Biggest Bet and Its Biggest Threat
items.excerpt: Rising AI costs, falling valuations, and a wave of AI-native rivals are converging on the design giant.

items.title: Amazon’s new Shop Direct Merchant Workspace makes it even easier for stores across the web to have their products discovered by customers on Alexa for Shopping and Amazon
items.excerpt: Tens of millions of customers have already discovered hundreds of millions of products from stores across the web through Amazon’s Shop Direct. With the new Shop Direct Merchant Workspace, merchants have a fast, free direct AI connector from their store to Alexa for Shopping and Amazon.
